newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb Genetics estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb Genetics estimates raised.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said on Wednesday that she raised her earnings estimates for DeKalb Genetics Corp for fiscal 1997 to $1.35 a share from $1.25 and for fiscal 1998 to $1.65 from $1.50.
-- Wittenburg also reiterated her buy rating on the stock of the seed company.
-- On Tuesday, DeKalb said it expects higher earnings for fiscal 1997. It added that unit margins in fiscal 1997 for its North American corn business would be higher than originally expected.
-- DeKalb shares were up one at 39-1/4.

-- Wittenburg also said DeKalb is raising seed corn prices about seven percent, including mix gains. However, research and development spending will be up about $10 million from $40 million spent last year.

-- "The company's goal is to increase market share by (one-half) percentage point, but we believe that the opportunity is greater than that given good product performance and good seed supplies," she said.
